title: Compare the Helios X1 and Vega Pro 14 laptops

data.query: Compare the Helios X1 and Vega Pro 14 laptops
data.answer:
Our picks under $1,000 this season are the Helios X1 ($899), the Vega Pro 14 ($949), the Nimbus Air 13 ($749), the Atlas 15 ($699) and the Corvo 16 ($999). [1]

### Details
- The Vega Pro 14 costs $949 with a 14-inch OLED display, 16 GB of RAM and a 512 GB SSD. [2]
- Vega Pro 14 стоит 949 долларов, у него OLED-экран 14 дюймов и 16 ГБ памяти. [3]
- The Helios X1 costs $899 and has a 14-inch 2.8K display, 16 GB of RAM and a 1 TB SSD. [4]
- Ноутбук Helios X1 стоит 899 долларов, у него 14-дюймовый экран 2.8K и 16 ГБ памяти. [5]
